               <milestone n="Colophon (62a8-62a9)" unit="section"/> mkhas btsun bzang 3 gyi <expan>yon tan</expan> rnaMs la <expan>thogs</expan> pa med pa'i mkhyen pa dang ldan pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhas btsun <expan>shes rab</expan> bzang po</rs> <note type="editorial">Could be Sa skya Shes rab bzang po (ID: 7636)?</note> <expan>de dag gi</expan> bka' drin las stod <expan>gsum gyi</expan> tshul la <expan>blo gros</expan> kyi snang ba mched pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5963">shAkya'i dge sbyong <expan>dpal gyi</expan> ming 'chang ba</rs>s chu mo <expan>lug gi</expan> lo'i sa <choice><sic>kha</sic><corr>ga</corr></choice> <expan>chen po</expan>'i zla ba la | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5733">dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag <lb n="62a9"/> khang</rs> du bris pa 'dis kyang | bstan pa dang <expan>sems can</expan> la phan ‹pa› rgya chen byed par gyur 1 ||</seg></TEI>
